text:
Maria: quick heads-up — planning a staged enable for model nebula-13b-v2 in the catalog tonight. change window 03:00-04:00 UTC. will do canary (1%), ramp (25%), pin. need final fallback ordering and rollback owners.

Jon: thanks — I can own rollback and postmortem if something blows up. what are our canary success criteria?

Maria: @Jon success criteria: 95th perc latency < 120ms, error rate < 0.5% for 30m, and no semantic regressions on the smoke prompt set. if any trigger fails, we abort and roll back to nebula-13b-v1.

Kai: double-checking resource constraints — quant variant will be served on dedicated pools; if we hit OOMs fallback should prefer nebula-13b-v1-quant-overprovisioned -> nebula-7b-fallback. ordering: prefer same-arch quant first, then lower-capacity safe model.

Priya: noted. I recommend the fallback priority list be: nebula-13b-v1 (full), nebula-13b-v1-quant (if compatible), nebula-7b-safe. Also add a TTL on fallback of 15m to avoid oscillation.

SRE-Oncall: add probing: before canary open a quick warmup job: `curl -X POST https://catalog.health/check -d '{"model":"nebula-13b-v2","warm":true}'` and validate KV cache priming; if warmup fails, do not start canary.

DeployBot: ACTION: create rollout job. scheduled windows: canary start=2024-05-04T03:05:00Z, ramp start=2024-05-04T03:20:00Z, pin start=2024-05-04T03:45:00Z. canary targets=1% traffic, ramp targets=25%. rollback-on: latency_threshold=120ms, error_rate=0.5%. owner=@Jon.

Jon: confirmed. I'll monitor metrics and will trigger `deploybot rollback <rollout-id>` if we breach. what about release notes / customer comms?

Maria: small release note — "nebula-13b-v2: improved instr-following, cost parity with v1". No external customer broadcast unless we hit visible regressions. internal RU: product and support pinged.

Priya: I'll add a safety gate in Console: abort if stderr spike > 0.2% and push a canary-only blacklist for top prompt IDs that flapped during internal QA.

SRE-Oncall: oncall will set up extra alerting: dashboard tile + a temporary slack #ops-cutover thread. if rollback happens, annotate the incident with deploy id and stack traces.

Maria: perfect. last ask: @DeployBot, annotate rollout with `fallback_tier=["nebula-13b-v1","nebula-13b-v1-quant","nebula-7b-safe"]` and `fallback_ttl=900s`.

DeployBot: UPDATED: rollout 2024-05-04-03:05Z annotated with fallback_tier and fallback_ttl. Preflight check passed: warmup ok, slot allocation ok. Proceeding per schedule unless human abort. :rocket:

Jon: I'll be live on the watch call and will shout here if I hit any triggers. thanks team. :thumbsup:

Maria: thanks all — will post a single-line status after pin.
